text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Man, talk about being a letdown… I thought I would win for sure this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can't blame Kitasan Black for being upset about her placement, considering my own disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I can't possibly return the favor to everyone who's been cheering me on at this rate…

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Make it up to them by winning next time!
No time for moping! Let's get back to training right away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
choice_data_list: Use this loss as a stepping stone to your next goal!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I'm so lucky to have you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Your encouragement's helped calm me down a bit, so thanks. I know I'll be fine at my next race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You're right. We can't afford to waste any time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Even if it seems like I'll be left in the dust… No, it's exactly because I'll get left in the dust that I have to buckle down and keep trying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black's firm resolution bolsters my heart as well.
